name: Scaring Shaky
summary: "Sea Wolf" MacKinley can't stand unpaid gambling debts, and plenty of people owe him. First is "Shaky" Phillipe by the docks in Booty Bay, who still owes a good deal from last week's game. MacKinley's plan is a scare, using giblets from Elder Mistvale Gorillas.

sections.title: Collecting a Debt
sections.body: "Sea Wolf" MacKinley cannot abide gambling debts left unpaid, and many people owe. First among them is "Shaky" Phillipe, who is by the docks and whose debt from last week's game is large. The way to collect is to frighten Phillipe. You are sent out of town to hunt Elder Mistvale Gorillas and bring back a good haul of giblets for Phillipe. MacKinley wants it kept quiet that they came from an animal, so that Phillipe imagines the worst.

sections.title: Phillipe's Reaction
sections.body: Phillipe recoils at the giblets and does not want to know where they came from. Then Phillipe asks whether Sea Wolf sent you.

faq.answer: MacKinley is owed gambling debts by many people and wants help collecting them, starting with "Shaky" Phillipe.

faq.q: Why does MacKinley want to scare "Shaky" Phillipe?
faq.answer: Phillipe still owes MacKinley a large sum from last week's game, and MacKinley thinks a fright is the way to get paid.

aliases: what do i kill for giblets
faq.answer: Elder Mistvale Gorillas, which MacKinley says are found outside town.
Down by the docks in Booty Bay.

faq.q: What should you tell Phillipe about the giblets?
aliases: do i tell shaky where giblets came from
faq.answer: Nothing. MacKinley wants Phillipe to imagine the worst, so the giblets' animal origin is not to be mentioned.
